no-cook-0-paneer-salad.title: No-cook Paneer chopped salad
ingredients: Optional: 2 tbsp hung curd for binding
steps: Wash hands. Chop cucumber + onion into bite-size pieces.
Prepare Paneer (drain paneer/tofu, open yogurt/cottage, or use leftover cooked protein).
Mix protein + veggies in a bowl. Add jeera-dhania and salt.
Squeeze lemon and toss gently until coated.
Taste and adjust salt/lemon. Eat soon for best crunch.
Store leftovers airtight up to 12 hours (keep lemon separate if possible).
no-cook-0-paneer-salad.tips: Use leftover grilled protein from yesterday to build this even faster.
tasteTweaks: Want more flavour? Finish with lemon and a pinch of jeera-dhania.
If you like spicy: add ½ green chilli or red chilli flakes while cooking.
If you do NOT like spicy: skip chilli; use black pepper + lemon only.
Optional boost: 1 tsp hung curd or a few roasted peanuts for crunch.
Meal-prep: keep spice temper / dressing separate; mix just before eating.

If you do NOT like spicy: skip chilli; use black pepper + lemon only.
Optional boost: 1 tsp hung curd or a few roasted peanuts for crunch.
